title: Generalizing HVAC Control With Domain Randomized Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.05822v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deploying advanced HVAC (Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning) controllers at scale remains difficult because performance often depends on accurate building models or per-site retuning. We propose NOMAD-RL (Neural Online Meta-Adaptation for Dynamics), a general-purpose Reinforcement Learning (RL) controller designed to transfer across heterogeneous thermal zones through a universal, non-invasive thermostat interface. The controller acts on temperature setpoints from zone measurements and forecasts, while a recurrent policy supports online adaptation under partial observability.   Our main contribution is an adaptive domain randomization scheme based on physics-informed normalizing flows, which models correlated and multimodal distributions of thermal-zone parameters while maintaining physical plausibility and controllability. This produces a realistic and progressively adaptive training curriculum that improves transfer across build

translated_title: 基于域随机化强化学习的HVAC控制泛化方法
translated_abstract: 大规模部署先进的HVAC（供暖、通风与空调）控制器仍然十分困难，因为其性能往往依赖于精确的建筑模型或针对每个现场进行的重新调参。我们提出了NOMAD-RL（Neural Online Meta-Adaptation for Dynamics，面向动力学的神经在线元自适应），这是一个通用的强化学习（RL）控制器，旨在通过一个通用的、非侵入式的恒温器接口，在异构的热区之间实现迁移。该控制器基于区域温度测量值和预测值对温度设定点进行操作，同时其循环策略支持在部分可观测条件下的在线自适应。我们的主要贡献是一种基于物理信息归一化流的自适应域随机化方案，该方案在保持物理合理性和可控性的同时，能够对热区参数的相关性和多峰分布进行建模。由此产生了一个逼真且渐进自适应的训练课程，改善了跨建筑的迁移能力（原文摘要到此被截断）。
tldr: 提出了基于物理信息归一化流的自适应域随机化强化学习控制器NOMAD-RL，无需精确建筑模型或现场调参，即可通过通用非侵入式恒温器接口在异构热区之间实现HVAC控制的泛化迁移。
en_tdlr: NOMAD-RL is a general-purpose reinforcement learning HVAC controller that leverages adaptive domain randomization based on physics-informed normalizing flows to generalize across heterogeneous thermal zones without requiring accurate building models or per-site retuning.
